title: Continuation procedure after dev5 Rasen Falcon identity-role packaging
summary: Continue from the dev5 candidate plus the last full dev3 r13196 baseline. The LDAP identity role is now the reference consumer for exact namespace launch; next programme consumers are SMTP/IMAP, private/public HTTPS and website roles, while live activation remains operator-gated.
invariants: Do not let the first consumer turn into permanent Audio-specific behavior in Deployment.
For production release dependencies, prefer current SSC QUALIFIED sealed deployments and exact dependency deployment ids.
Never replace source.get_deployment_package/getDeploymentPackage sealed semantics with floating development resolution.
Materialise exact package bytes into a deterministic namespace and use the same generated REXX_PATH for qualification and launch.
A hosted-module change must be exercised with a real host/package composition, not only a fake route class.
A native repair change must exercise both reuse and rebuild/fail-closed paths.
A concurrency change must prove same-target single-flight and independent-target parallelism.
Promote a new executable baseline only with explicit runtime qualification evidence; update package hash, sphere and continuity together.

provenance.claim: Current concrete consumer and continuation boundary.
Current continuation authority for sealed SSC production dependency path.
Current qualification includes real SSC dependency resolution.
Current executable dependency implementation and hosted ordering.
First fleet run supplies concurrency/readiness lessons still driving later revisions.

procedure: Resolve/load the oorexx-deployment sphere; read start, qualification, rasenfalcon-identity-role, known-gaps and ssc-sealed-deployments.
Verify the dev5 candidate hash and dev3 last full runtime-qualified baseline hash.
For each Rasen Falcon role, consume the component-owned service/bootstrap contract rather than inventing a second daemon or authority.
Obtain or verify exact sealed dependency namespace and use launch_oorexx_namespace.sh so ambient REXX_PATH cannot alter authority.
Keep release check/install/start/verify/accept distinct; unavailable live evidence is NOT_RUN.
Reconcile the Rasen Falcon controller unit inventory with HOSTS.json; NOC and Office private HTTPS remain separate role-specific services.
Extend the same role-builder pattern to SMTP/IMAP and HTTPS/website only after their owned service contracts are current.
Promote a new executable baseline only with explicit r13196 and live-consumer evidence; update package hash, sphere and Rasen Falcon lane together.
